description_en: Deletes an IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-ipv6-translator-entry --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-translator-entry-id ipv6transentry-bp1g8bhrde0000 --ipv6-translator-id ipv6trans-bp1858ys0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteIPv6TranslatorEntry

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。 您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service mapping entry to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的IPv6转换服务映射条目ID。
parameters.name: ipv6_translator_entry_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the IPv6 Translation Service.

If you do not specify the Ipv6TranslatorEntryId parameter, all mapping entries of the specified instance are deleted
parameters.help_zh:
IPv6转换服务的实例ID。 

如果您不指定Ipv6TranslatorEntryId参数，则删除指定实例下所有的映射条目。
parameters.name: ipv6_translator_id
